Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
-----
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Lalit Yadav, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Saket Kumar, A.P.P
 -----
 02/Dated: 06/06/2023

Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Baghmara P.S. Case No.52 of 2022, for the offence under Sections 323/ 341/
354B/ 498A/ 504/ 34 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of D.P. Act.

Issue notice to the O.P. No.2, under registered cover with A/D as well as by ordinary process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks failing which this case shall stands rejected without further reference to the Bench.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that it is the second F.I.R.
Since it is a matrimonial dispute, I am inclined to grant the privilege of provisional anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, the above named applicant is directed to surrender in the Court below and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the Court below shall enlarge the above named applicant,
on provisional bail for three months from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Dhanbad in connection with Baghmara P.S. Case No.52 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
Further, the applicant will submit self-attested copy of his Aadhaar Card and also give his mobile number before the learned court below, which he will not change during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
Jaswant Saw vs The State Of Jharkhand on 6 June, 2023
